title: Track the cloud-placeholder harness as an opt-in test against the shipped Scanner
how_to_read: Each attempt is one line and a `details` filename in this same directory. Open a detail file ONLY when this index points you at one -- the summaries are here so you do not have to. `caused_by` is what sent the stage back; `changed` is what the attempt then touched, counted by kind. Several attempts in a row that were caused by the same stage and changed no `src` is a loop, not progress.

open.issue: Derived 1: the cloud-placeholder harness is tracked in the repository, not only as scratch in %TEMP%\taad-sl024-respike: partial
Derived 2: the harness exists as an xunit test in tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests: missing
Derived 3: the test drives the shipped Scanner.Scan and SynchronousIoCancel on a real cf-filter folder, not a harness copy of the guard: missing
Derived 4: the test is opt-in, excluded from the default run by a Trait and the project's default filter, and not by Skip: partial
Derived 5 (premise, not a deliverable): a separate-process provider with sync-root flag 2 runs unelevated, so a Trait-gated test is feasible: partial

May validate run `--filter Cloud=CF-SYNC-ROOT` on this PC? It registers a real cldflt sync root under %TEMP% (unelevated) and removes it. SL-024 validate declined the equivalent step, and only the spike stage has run it here. Without that run, the deliverable (a test driving the shipped Scanner and SynchronousIoCancel on a real cf-filter folder) stays unproven in the repo's own build.

Is it acceptable that a cancelled stalled cloud folder shows as an empty Folder in a Cancelled result and not in Unreadable? The test pins this as it is today. If the person wants such a folder reported as not read, that is a separate scanner slice, and this test's characterization assertion changes with it.

CfProvider is in FsAnalyser.slnx and ProjectReferenced, against the StallRig and FsaWindowHook precedent of staying outside the slnx and being script-built, and against a literal reading of the recorded 'no new test framework or project' line.

The stall Fact pins 'stall not in Unreadable' as a characterization of a behaviour that may be a scanner gap. The alternative is to assert only cancel timing and the kept files, so a later fix does not have to edit the test.
The guard Fact covers every Trait pair in the assembly, so a future non-opt-in Trait would fail it. The alternative is to scope it to the Network and Cloud keys.
Trait key Cloud=CF-SYNC-ROOT, against the survey's suggested Network=CLOUD-PLACEHOLDER.

The rig, the two Facts and the cldapi import share one file (CloudPlaceholderTests.cs) so the confinement rule has one exception. Splitting them would read better but costs a second except_files entry.
